content: Add an API endpoint that decides whether an account can increase its monthly send limit.
I will write a new validator, database fetch helper, policy rule, persistence helper, and response formatter from scratch.
I am copying an older FastAPI endpoint into the prompt so I can adapt the pattern.
I will add a plain database write first and think about idempotency later.
AIDevObserver found evaluate_send_limit_policy and persist_policy_decision after the agent implemented a duplicate version.
I will keep both implementations for now and choose later.
AIDevObserver should catch duplicate policy helpers, missed idempotency wrapper, and context waste from copying old endpoint code into the prompt.
